Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than initially expected, which has moved the delivery date by two weeks. The new delivery date is 14 April.

Our team is continuing work on all remaining components in parallel so that this is the only adjustment needed to the schedule. We're confirming certification status daily with the third-party provider and will flag immediately if anything changes on their end. Would 14 April still work well for your internal planning, or is there a preferred window we should aim to fit around?

In the meantime, we'll send a short progress update each week so you have full visibility into where things stand. Please let us know if there's anything specific you'd like us to prioritize as we move toward the new date, and we'll factor that into the remaining work.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
